title: fix: provision production dashboard session secrets
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Fixes production KPI, Economics, and Observability failing to check sessions because `POLLINATIONS_AUTH_SESSION_SECRET` was never provisioned.
- Adds distinct, explicitly approved session secrets to the three encrypted production stores; existing credentials and ciphertext are unchanged.
- Includes the session secret in Observability’s required Worker upload list and rejects missing configuration.
- Validation: SOPS integrity and secret isolation checks, Biome, deployment discovery tests, and the real Observability provisioning regression test pass.
- Rollout: merge to main, promote through a separate main → production PR, then verify production session endpoints and independent login/logout. No secrets have been uploaded from this branch.

gist.headline: Three doors, proper keys
gist.blurb: The production dashboards have received their missing session keys. KPI, Economics, and Observability can now recognize a returning visitor instead of staring politely into the void.
gist.summary: Provisioned distinct POLLINATIONS_AUTH_SESSION_SECRET values for the KPI, Economics, and Observability production secret stores, and made Observability reject uploads missing its session-secret configuration.
gist.impact: Production KPI, Economics, and Observability dashboards can now validate sessions reliably, including independent login and logout flows after rollout.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed dashboard with three labeled little doors for KPI, Economics, and Observability, each receiving its own glowing key. Polli, wearing a tiny locksmith tool belt, checks the keys while code-plants grow around the secure session terminal.
